updates.title: Tool Equip & Playback Fix
changes: Fixed tool equip causing double speed during playback
Fixed pause/resume playback not working properly
Added fingerprint matching for tools (name, tooltip, color, config)
Unified tool handling for both Flexible and Strict mode
Added throttle to prevent rapid tool re-equip

updates.title: Loop Playback Fix
changes: Fixed loop playback not working properly
Fixed travel phase not walking to start position
Fixed race condition when loop is enabled

updates.title: Morph Avatar
changes: Added Morph Avatar feature to Fun tab
Added live avatar preview before morphing

updates.title: Pathfinding & Visuals Update
changes: Smart Resume: Character now walks to resume point instead of teleporting
High Precision Path: Smoother and more accurate path visualization
Fixed pathfinding timeout and stuck issues
